title: Gemini chat gains built-in tools
summary:
Gemini gained built-in tools, while the community added a small ecosystem of storytelling, creative, learning, and coding projects.

The chat API now accepts Gemini tool types for code execution, Google Search, Maps, URL context, computer use, and file search alongside OpenAI-style function tools. The `gemini` model defaults to code execution, Search, and URL context when a request supplies no tools; explicitly supplied tools take precedence.

The community project listings added NIKKE roleplay with responsive Live2D characters, a no-code builder for choice-based games, D&D character sheets, illustrated and narrated story tools, a historical scene generator, and a Gorilla Tag mod menu with a Pollinations-powered assistant. Several PRs listed the same projects more than once; they represent distinct apps, not extra launches.

New community listings cover browser-based image studios, a Telegram art bot, a multi-style image generator, and a video editor for shorts and documentaries. Two WordPress plugins use Pollinations text and images for content workflows, including turning RSS items into posts.

highlights.title: Gemini gets built-in tools
highlights.text: Send Gemini built-in tools such as `code_execution`, `google_search`, and `url_context` through the chat API. With no tools specified, `gemini` uses those three by default. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
